title: Pan-Seared Mushrooms with Crispy German Skillet
description: A quick Italian dish featuring pan-seared mushrooms and crispy German skillet, served with a side of garlic
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the sliced German skillet and fry until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and fry until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the mushrooms with the crispy German skillet and a side of garlic.
